mechanism: diagnose_repetition: consecutive identical n-gram blocks (n=1..4); pathological at run >= 6, or >= 4 when the span decodes denser than 6 words/s; commit lane RETRIES once (the CPU service path is measurably nondeterministic — service-anomaly.json), then TRIMS the run to two occurrences; seam-collapse prevents trimmed spans re-assembling a loop across commits; hot-lane partials trimmed for display
legitimate_repetition_law: 'हाँ हाँ, बिल्कुल' and 'नहीं नहीं, मैं नहीं गया' are runs of 2 and are unit-pinned untouchable; relaxed spans allow runs up to 5
never_silent: every detection and trim logs loudly (realtime_repetition_detected / realtime_repetition_trimmed) and counts in the session summary (repetition_detected, repetition_retries, trimmed_words)
unit_laws: 8 dedicated tests incl. a deliberately loopy engine: partials AND finals carry runs <= 2, text never emptied; duration-scaled max_tokens (M53) stays as the outer bound
in_the_wild: repetition_detected = 0 across the entire M54 battery and drills — the M53 event did not recur; the guard is the seatbelt
ui_exposure: none — telemetry names are internal-only; no event field or UI copy carries them
